units.source_text: 于是……他巧妙地找到不需忍饿、堂而皇之吃饭的借口，松了一口气……

en.t: And so... he cleverly found an excuse that let him eat openly without having to endure hunger, and he breathed a sigh of relief...

units.source_text: 忽然，眼界敞开了，他解开了思考的结头。

en.t: Suddenly, his field of vision opened up, and he untied the knot in his thinking.

units.source_text: 说到底，对手不就是沙子吗？

en.t: After all, was his opponent not simply the sand?

units.source_text: 于是，也就不可能有“冲破铁笼子”等无理要求了。

en.t: In that case, there was no need for impossible demands like breaking through an iron cage.

units.source_text: 绳梯给拿走了，做个木梯子不就行了吗？

en.t: If the rope ladder had been taken away, would it not be enough to make a wooden ladder?

units.source_text: 沙壁太陡，就铲掉一些，让它的倾斜再舒缓一点不就得了吗……

en.t: If the sand wall was too steep, he could just shovel some away and make the slope a little gentler...

units.source_text: 只要稍微开动些脑筋，唰地一下如你所见到的……

en.t: If he only used his head a little, then in a flash, just as you can see...

units.source_text: 看上去也许过于简单，但真正要达到目的，最需要的就是简单的想法。

en.t: It might look overly simple, but to truly reach the goal, what was needed most was a simple idea.

units.source_text: 就像哥伦布用鸡蛋来打比方那样，真正正确的解答，常常简单到近乎不值一提的程度。

en.t: Just as Columbus illustrated with the egg, the truly correct answer is often so simple that it almost seems not worth mentioning.
As long as he was not afraid of trouble...
As long as he had the determination to struggle...

units.source_text: 远远没有到万事俱休的地步。

en.t: Things were still far from the point where everything was over.
